answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to make every participant lock real value in a shared vault before it may earn, propose, or grade. Disposable identities then cost money, so flooding the network with clones stops being free. Slashing dishonest work keeps the pressure on, while reputation that survives repeated review forms a high mesa no newcomer can fake overnight. Cheap disposable accounts still drift at the edges like a lagoon, but the vault gate keeps the core honest.
